vuln.name: Chinese Mobile Phone Number Disclosed
vuln.description: A response body contains what matches the format of a Chinese mobile phone number (11 digits starting with the 1x pattern of a carrier).
vuln.impact: Disclosure of mobile numbers is a privacy breach under PIPL and enables spam, SIM-swap, and social-engineering attacks.
vuln.recommendation: Remove phone numbers from the response. Mask or tokenize PII and restrict access to it.
